## Commutative · Change the order {#fv1-commutative .fv-lesson }

```{=html}
<p>An operation is <strong>commutative</strong> when changing the order does not change the result.</p><div class="fv-equation"><span data-math="\displaystyle \textcolor{#217864}{3}\times\textcolor{#ad6e32}{5}=\textcolor{#ad6e32}{5}\times\textcolor{#217864}{3}"></span></div><div class="fv-equation"><span data-math="\displaystyle ab=ba"></span></div>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet §1.1 · p. 1</div>

::: {.notes}
About one minute. The factors exchange positions. Multiplication of real numbers is commutative. Keep the definition distinct from changing brackets.
:::
